enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping overnight with the fan on for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn the body onto the left side. Push the pillow with the hand. Stretch the legs. Turn the head away from the fan. Pull the blanket down to the waist. Turn the body onto the back. Move the arm onto the pillow. Turn the head to the side. Pull the blanket up again. Turn the body onto the right side. Keep the fan running on the bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the body dry. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, toasting bread and boiling the kettle for tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread bag on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cupboard door. Take out a cup and a plate. Close the cupboard door. Place the cup on the counter. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up the butter from the refrigerator. Take out a knife from the drawer. Spread butter on the toasted bread. Put the toast on the plate. Pour hot water into the cup. Dip the tea bag into the cup. Pick up the plate. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate and cup. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University Clayton campus while reviewing lecture notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the backpack. Put the backpack on the shoulders. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Unlock the phone screen. Open the lecture notes file. Scroll down the notes with the thumb. Read the notes. Look up at the road. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Take out the phone again. Scroll the notes. Read the notes. Look at the stop display. Stand up. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk to the campus gate. Walk along the path to the building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the lecture hall. Walk down the row of seats. Sit on a seat. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the lecture slide file. Take out a notebook and pen. Write down the lecture points. Raise the hand to ask a question. Answer the tutor's question. Type notes on the keyboard. Close the laptop lid after the lecture. Put the laptop into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the lecture hall. Walk to the tutorial room. Sit at a table with classmates. Open the textbook. Turn the pages. Discuss the case study with the group. Take turns reading the questions aloud. Write the group answers on the whiteboard. Erase the whiteboard with the duster. Pack the textbook into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the tutorial room.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and chatting briefly with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the campus food court. Stand in the queue. Order a rice bowl at the counter. Tap the card on the payment reader. Pick up the tray. Carry the tray to a table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice and the side dishes. Sip water from the bottle. Turn the head toward the classmates. Talk with classmates about the group project. Nod the head at their reply. Pick up the tray. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return trolley. Place the tray down. Walk out of the food court.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library, working on assignments and group project tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the library. Swipe the student card at the gate. Walk to an empty desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the password. Open the assignment document. Type text on the keyboard. Click the mouse to open the reference page. Read the reference article on the screen. Highlight text with the mouse. Type more paragraphs. Open the group chat window. Send a message to the group. Read the reply in the chat. Open the shared project file. Edit the section assigned. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Take the water bottle out of the backpack. Unscrew the cap. Drink water. Screw the cap back on. Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop into the backpack. Push the chair back under the desk. Stand up. Walk out of the library.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling to Chadstone for the afternoon retail shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the bus timetable app. Check the arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Put the backpack on the lap. Take out the phone. Scroll the messages. Look at the stop display. Stand up. Pull the backpack onto the shoulders. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk to the shopping centre entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Put the backpack into the locker. Take out the work shirt. Put on the work shirt. Close the locker. Clip the name badge onto the shirt. Walk to the shop floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone, serving customers and restocking shelves
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the counter. Press the register power button. Log in to the register with the staff code. Greet the first customer. Scan the item barcode with the scanner. Press the total button. Say the total price to the customer. Take the card from the customer. Tap the card on the reader. Hand the card and receipt back to the customer. Say thank you to the customer. Walk to the stockroom. Pick up a box of stock. Carry the box to the shelf. Cut the box tape with the box cutter. Take out the folded garments. Fold the garments neatly. Place the garments on the shelf. Arrange the items by size. Turn the hanger rack around. Pick up the empty box. Carry the box to the stockroom. Flatten the box. Place the box in the cardboard bin. Walk back to the shop floor. Help a customer find a size. Walk to the fitting room. Count the items in the fitting room. Hang the returned garments back on the rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Straighten the display table. Greet the next customer. Scan the items. Process the payment. Say goodbye to the customer. Check the time on the register screen. Log out of the register.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from Chadstone after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take off the work shirt. Put on the casual shirt. Take the backpack out of the locker. Close the locker. Walk out of the shopping centre. Push the glass door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Put the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk to the front door. Take out the keys. Unlock the front door. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a late dinner, reheating rice in the microwave and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the rice container and the vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Take off the container lid. Place the container into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the timer buttons. Press the start button. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl and chopsticks. Close the cupboard door. Open the microwave door when the beep sounds. Take out the container. Pour the rice into the bowl. Sit down at the table. Eat the rice with the chopsticks. Drink water from the cup. Stand up. Carry the bowl and chopsticks to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl with water. Scrub the bowl with the sponge. Rinse the chopsticks. Place the bowl and chopsticks on the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch watching TV to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the couch. Lean back against the cushion. Press the channel button on the remote. Watch the programme on the screen. Press the volume up button. Put the remote on the cushion beside. Take out the phone. Unlock the screen. Scroll the social media feed. Press the like button on a post. Lock the phone. Put the phone on the table. Pick up the remote again. Change the channel. Watch the programme. Press the power button on the remote. Stand up from the couch. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing lecture slides and finishing coursework on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Turn on the fan. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the lecture slide file. Scroll through the slides with the mouse. Open the assignment document. Type text on the keyboard. Click the mouse to insert a table. Type the table content. Open the browser tab. Search for a reference article. Read the article on the screen. Copy the citation text. Paste the citation into the document. Save the file. Close the document window. Shut down the computer. Stand up. Push the chair back under the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Pick up the phone. Walk to the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and brushing teeth before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Wipe the body dry. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put down the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone in bed before falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Unlock the phone screen. Open the reading app. Scroll the page with the thumb. Read the text on the screen. Press the page turn button. Continue reading. Open the browser. Scroll the news feed. Press on a video post. Watch the video on the screen. Close the app. Lock the phone. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Close eyes.
